title: Talent Acquisition Intern
description:
We are looking for talent acquisition candidates who can participate in our internship program. Candidates who make successful placements will be hired as Talent Acquisition Executives with Industry\-standard salaries. During the internship program, candidates are also eligible for commission\-based remuneration for every successful hire.
 



  





 Role: Talent Acquisition Intern
 



 Experience: Nil / Fresher
 



 Location: Remote (Anywhere)
 



 Internship Period: 2 Months
 



  





 Day\-to\-day responsibilities:
 


* Sourcing, and screening high\-quality candidates from job portals and social media channels
* Talking to the right candidates \& explaining the accurate job description; generating the exact skill\-set of candidates/applicants
* Enable smooth onboarding of candidates by ensuring consistent liaison between your team and candidate pool.
* Scheduling Interviews
* Assist your team in handling end\-to\-end recruitment



  





 Required Skills:
 


* English Proficiency (Spoken \& Written)
* MS\-Excel



  





 Perks
 


* Certificate of Acknowledgement/Experience
* Letter of Recommendation
* Job offer, If found to be an Exceptional Performer

title: Human Resources Intern
description:
Role: HR Intern
   

 Mode:Remote and Flexible
   

  

 Responsibilities:
   

 \- Communicate effectively with team leaders and cross\-functional teams
   

 \- Attend regular team meetings and provide updates on assigned tasks
   

 \- Support active hiring processes, including sourcing and screening candidates
   

 \- Maintain accurate day\-to\-day records of HR activities and tasks
   

 \- Assist in recruitment and onboarding processes
   

  

 Requirements:
   

 \- Strong verbal and written communication skills
   

 \- Ability to work collaboratively with team members and reporting managers
   

 \- Basic understanding of HR functions (preferred, not mandatory)
   

 \- Organized and detail\-oriented approach to record\-keeping

title: Dispatch Associate (URGENT HIRING)
description:
About the job
 



  





 Whiz Delivery is a Canadian last\-mile delivery company operating in Ontario, Quebec, British Columbia, and Alberta. We take pride in handling every order with speed, precision, and care. We are seeking a
 **Dispatch Associate to join us immediately** 
 , helping us maintain efficiency, communicate effectively, and take ownership of their role.
 



  





 If you are
 **proactive, observant, resourceful, capable of working under minimal supervision, and have good presence of min** 
 d, this role could be your next big step. We offer the opportunity to grow professionally, acquire new skills, and assume greater responsibility over time, all while being part of an international team.
 



  





**What You’ll Do** 




**Pickup Coordination** 



* Coordinate daily pickups to ensure they run on time and without issues.
* Track order volumes, schedule drivers, and plan efficient routes.
* Assign vehicles and follow up to ensure safety and maintenance standards are met.
* Liaise with truck rental partners when vehicles are required or issues arise.
* Monitor drivers in real time and take quick initiative to resolve delays or incidents independently.



  





**Client \& Team Communication** 



* Communicate with clients and sellers via phone and email to confirm pickup times, provide updates, and manage last\-minute changes.
* Keep internal teams informed to ensure smooth operations between pickups and deliveries.
* Maintain accurate daily records to support transparency and accountability.



  





**Process Support** 



* Keep logs, records, reports, and checklists up to date.
* Assist with delivery dispatch during peak periods.
* Actively share process improvement ideas and take ownership of implementing small improvements to enhance system speed and reliability.



  





**What We’re Looking For** 



* 1–2 years of experience in dispatch or logistics coordination.
* Strong English communication skills; Hindi is an asset.
* Must have skills: Observation, Attention to Detail, Responsiveness, and Quick Action.
* Proven ability to take initiative, work independently, and make sound decisions with minimal supervision.
* Excellent problem\-solving skills and the ability to stay composed in a fast\-paced environment.
* Proficiency in Google Workspace, and Microsoft Office.
* Based in India and available during Eastern Standard Time business hours.
* Willingness to follow the Canadian work calendar and holidays, with flexibility for extended hours as needed.
* **Immediate availability to join.**



  





**Why Join Us** 



* Work for a growing Canadian company making an impact in logistics.
* Take ownership of meaningful work and grow your career in an international environment.
* Enjoy the freedom of a fully remote role while being part of a collaborative, supportive team.
* Be part of a culture that values initiative, accountability, and getting things done right.



  





**Work Schedule** 



* Monday to Friday: 11 am to 8 pm EST (full\-time)
* Sunday: 12 pm to 3 pm EST (on call)



  





**Compensation** 



* ₹40,000 per month in hand.
* ₹30,000 during the first 1\-month training period.
